node.title: Re^2: Any downsides to this slurp idiom?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Why not use [mod://File::Slurp]?

One reason is what [hippo] [id://1217222|said], the other being that this is IMO one of those cases where pure Perl does everything I need - I can read lines in list context and I can use layers like :raw, :crlf, and :encoding(...) - there's really no need to load a module. (Unless I'm doing additional stuff, like filename manipulation, in which case I usually use [mod://Path::Class], which has slurping and spewing built in.)
